# Purpose
This generated header defines the QUIC metrics metadata used by the metrics system in the codebase. It maps each metric to a fixed offset, a metric name, a metric type such as `FD_METRICS_TYPE_COUNTER`, `FD_METRICS_TYPE_GAUGE`, or `FD_METRICS_TYPE_HISTOGRAM`, and a short description that explains what the metric records.
